name: fetch-always-needs-timeout
hook: Always add AbortController timeout to fetch calls in React components
body: Without a timeout, a hanging fetch prevents the `finally` block from running, leaving `loading` state stuck at `true` forever. Always wrap fetch with `AbortController` and a `setTimeout` that calls `controller.abort()` after a reasonable timeout (e.g., 15s).
why: The MetricsProvider fetch had no timeout. When the API route hung, the `finally` block never ran and widgets showed 'Loading...' forever. This bug had multiple failed fix attempts (commits 6b527f1a8, b1b7df6a7, etc.) that were never merged.
